items.title: Willie "Old Man" Parker Interview, 1958-11-07
items.q: Yes, indeed. He'd come down there. He'd come to us, maybe Sunday. He'd stay with us two days.

ctx.x: This was down in the country?

Yes, indeed. He'd come down there. He'd come to us, maybe Sunday. He'd stay with us two days. Then he'd go to Dameron and stay two days. Then he'd go to Magnolia and stay two days, where the son of him would come from. He'd be taught all them bands. See, at that time they had bands. Magnolia, Point Lash, Derry, St. Sofa, Irontan, Bel-Air. Oakville, Judge and Bend. Oakville, George's Bend, all them places had a band, you see. And old hombre had all that voice. He didn't charge it for two bits of less. Two bits of…
Now, what kind of marches and things would they play? Would they play 6-H marches, funeral dirges? Would they play blues, mizzou?
